Name: Gentle Desaturation
Author: arexasly
Description:
[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Reduces the game's color saturation by an amount you choose.[/*]
[*]Small values give a gentle, hard-to-notice change. Larger values make the colors more muted.[/*]
[*]The strong, intense colors, like the bright yellows and greens, are where you'll notice it most.[/*]
[*]It doesn't change the game's art files, and it doesn't change gameplay.[/*]
[*]There are already mods like this but the one's I have tried don't allow you to set a specific amount or incorrectly colours some tiles. [/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]

You can change the amount in the mod's config file, or in game with Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it.
A restart is required for the change to apply.

I personally play on 10-13% reduction as it maintains the popping colours of Stardew without hurting your eyes after a while.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Reporting problems[/b][/size]

If something looks wrong, please post your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log) and what you were doing.

Downloads.Description: Set to 15% by default. Use GMCM to change the value.

Manifest.Name: Gentle Desaturation
Manifest.Description: Reduces the color saturation of the game's textures by a small, configurable amount (default 15%).
